hotfixes.name: vold-easyroms-write
hotfixes.title: Saving to the games card
hotfixes.description: let apps write saves to the games SD card under the default sdcardfs storage layer

hotfixes.name: soysauce-speaker
hotfixes.title: Soy Sauce speaker
hotfixes.description: Internal speaker fix for Soy Sauce V04 clones. Plays through the speaker and headphones together (like dArkOSRE), so the speaker works again. The headphone jack switch still mutes the speaker when you plug headphones in.

hotfixes.name: andr36oid-powermenu-dim
hotfixes.title: Power menu leaves screen dim
hotfixes.description: *Install after installation has fully completed* Fixes the screen staying dark after you open the shutdown menu and close it without picking anything. The menu dims and blurs the screen behind it, and that was not always cleared when the menu went away, so the home screen stayed darkened until something redrew it. This build also removes screen pinning, so it replaces the Stop screen pinning hotfix: delete no-screen-pinning.fix.zip if you have it.

hotfixes.name: usb-kbm-preset
hotfixes.title: USB keyboard & mouse
hotfixes.description: Adds a Keyboard & mouse USB preset that needs no image

hotfixes.name: andr36oid-usb-debug
hotfixes.title: USB debugging (adb)
hotfixes.description: Debugging only. Keeps the console in USB device (peripheral) mode with adb and USB debugging on across restarts, so a computer stays connected without re-picking Settings > USB mode. Do not charge the console while this is active: charging is not allowed in USB device mode (the DC port is the only charge port and must not be used in this mode). Do not plug a powered USB or OTG accessory into the OTG port either. Delete the zip to restore normal USB mode switching.

hotfixes.name: enable-any
hotfixes.title: Enable universal hotfixes
hotfixes.description: Lets hotfixes marked to work on any build apply on this release. Install it once and universal hotfixes work here too, without being tied to one specific build. Safe to leave installed.
